content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PJTSAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University, Agricultural College (PJTSAU) for filling up temporary posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in PJTSAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post name is Teaching Associate across specific departments like Biochemistry and Crop Physiology and Soil Science & Agril. Chemistry.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced under this recruitment notification for qualified agricultural science candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for PJTSAU Teaching Associate jobs?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through a Walk-in interview process. Eligible candidates can directly participate by visiting the designated venue on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. When is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 01 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they report to the venue on time along with proper documentation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc.(Ag.) in Crop Physiology or M.Sc.(Ag.) in Soil Science & Agril. Chemistry to be eligible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Teaching Associate positions?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary ranges from Rs. 49,000 to Rs. 54,000 per month without HRA, depending on whether the candidate holds an M.Sc. or a Ph.D. degree.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply for PJTSAU posts?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified or mentioned in the official notification released by the university for these temporary positions.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at Agricultural College, Palem, in the state of Telangana, with the pincode 509215 as per university guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry when attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their bio-data, all original educational certificates, mark sheets, ID proofs, and relevant documents along with self-attested photocopies.
